title: A filtered colimit of normal rings is normal
statement: Let $I$ be a small filtered category and $i\mapsto R_i$ a functor from $I$ to the category of commutative rings, with colimit $R=\varinjlim_IR_i$ in that category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. If every $R_i$ is a normal ring [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], then $R$ is a normal ring. (No condition on the transition maps.)
